$schema_note: Design tokens for every reel, ad, UGC video, carousel and thumbnail. Colors are a PROPOSAL until replaced with the real brand hex codes / logo.
name: Own It — creative system v1

ink.use: Primary dark: backgrounds, caption outline, body text on light

cream.use: Primary light: backgrounds, text on dark

plum.use: Brand color: lower thirds, end cards, wardrobe/set accent

gold.use: Highlight: the ONE keyword per caption line, numbers, money

coral.use: Action: CTA buttons, 'Stop'/'Wrong' words, progress bar. Max 1 use per frame

display.use: Hook text, thumbnail titles, big numbers. ALL CAPS.

accent.use: One emotional word per scene ('worth', 'yours'). Never a full sentence.

body.use: Carousel body, lower thirds, end card small print

type.source: All free on Google Fonts. Install the same fonts in CapCut / Premiere / Canva so every editor matches.

safe_zone_reel_px.why: IG/TikTok UI covers these. No text or faces' eyes there.

highlight.rule: 1 keyword per line: the number, the money word, or the emotion

caption_style.case: Sentence case. Hook only is ALL CAPS in Anton.
caption_style.animation: Pop-in 4 frames, scale 90%->100%. No bouncing, no rainbow karaoke.

motion.transitions: Hard cuts. Whip or match-cut max 2 per video. No dissolves, no star wipes.
motion.progress_bar: Optional 8px coral bar at very top for videos >30s

grade.look: Warm, clean, skin-first. Slight lift in shadows, never orange skin.

audio.sfx: Subtle whoosh on cuts that change topic, 'ding' only on the payoff number. Max 3 SFX per 30s.

logo_and_end_card.layout: Plum background, cream Anton CTA, gold handle underline
logo_and_end_card.watermark: Handle bottom-left inside safe zone, 40% opacity, Inter 32px. Never cover the face.
